the T cell response to the different Leishmania antigems is highly variable in both patients cured of visceral and in patients cured of the cutaneous disease.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the T cell response to the major surface proteases of the different Leishmania species is different.
the Thl‐type response to L. donovani antigens is not a prerequisite for cure of visceral leishmaniais.
